title: A domestic ending beyond preserving comfort

captions.physics: Ending unnecessary domestic methods and procedures
captions.energy: Hiding tension to preserve earlier convenience

meaning: Your domestic support becomes freer when an ending permits discussion of attachment instead of patiently preserving comfort already restricting both people’s choices.
text: You can finish a domestic task that has lost its purpose and change the form of participation. Death in the physical position of Muladhara describes this ending. Strength in energy complicates it through excessive containment of tension. The Devil in emotions holds to familiar material possibility. Transition can meet silent endurance. Both see maintenance becoming heavy but find rejection difficult. Familiar comfort supposedly matters more than present freedom, while not becoming irritated seems proof that the former form can still continue without review.

For example, you want a rarely used large coffee service removed. Washing and storage are inconvenient, but the possibility of beautiful presentation holds you, preserving work patiently. **Being able to endure maintenance does not make attachment a compulsory domestic need.** Its appeal can be recognised and actual use assessed. An ending restores choice without first requiring sharp refusal before permission to release space from an object promising more convenience than it currently gives.

The difficulty is preserving peace through unnamed work. A valued possibility remains while calm participation diminishes. Distinguishing value from untouchability offers more dependable support: pleasant things need not remain in full quantity. Transition ends excess without devaluing a good intention or making patience an indefinite agreement to maintain every earlier material promise of shared domestic comfort.
